sloka: उपरुध्यन्ति मे प्राणा दृष्टिर् भ्रमति राघव ।पश्यामि वृक्षान् सौवर्णान् उशीर कृत मूर्धजान् ॥३-६८-११॥
transliteration: uparudhyanti me prāṇā dṛṣṭir bhramati rāghava ।paśyāmi vṛkṣān sauvarṇān uśīra kṛta mūrdhajān ॥3-68-11॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghu race, I am gasping for breath. My eyes are reeling. I see root hair growing on the tops of golden trees.
